input.claim_text: On 14 March 2024 the flexible hose under my kitchen sink burst while I was at work, and by the time I got home water had flooded the cabinetry and part of the timber flooring. I've had to pull out the swollen cabinet base and the floorboards are warped. My policy number is HM-2298471. I'm hoping to get quotes but think it will cost around $4,500 to fix. Insurer: RealInsurance home insurance.
